packet.title: EXI pre-compression
packet.summary: The pre-compression alignment in both directions: the structure channel, value channels by qualified name, blocks of blockSize values.

body.p: After 8.5. EXI 1.0, section 9 ("EXI Compression") but DEFLATE.

item.p: Mechanism: src/exi_channel.c: the encoder buffers a block's values per and writes them in channel order; the decoder reads the structure channel first, then hands values out of the channels.
Done when: every decode and encode check of the pre-compression sets passes and is in the ratchet.
